name: Keema Matar
description: Pakistani keema matar with minced beef and green peas cooked in a concentrated onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic and warming spices.
ingredients: 2 medium onions, finely sliced or chopped
1 tsp red chilli powder, or to taste
method: Heat oil in a wide pan and cook the onions until softened and lightly browned, then add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until its raw aroma reduces.
Add the beef mince and break it up thoroughly with a spoon. Cook until the meat changes colour and excess released moisture begins to evaporate.
Add the tomatoes, chilli powder, cumin, turmeric and salt. Cook while stirring until the tomatoes soften and the masala becomes cohesive.
Add the peas and only a small splash of water if the pan needs moisture for them to cook. Cover and simmer gently until the peas are tender and the beef is cooked through.
Uncover and cook to the consistency you prefer, stirring so the keema stays moist rather than reducing until tough or dry.
Taste for seasoning, garnish with fresh coriander if available and serve hot with roti, naan or rice.
